ig_caption:
The shaking was never a sign you were weak.
When your hands shake before you act, that is your power arriving faster than your body can hold it. Wait for calm first and the drum goes inside, into your jaw and your chest.
Today, start one postponed thing for just 60 seconds.
Comment DRUM if your hands have ever shook and you did it anyway, and send this to someone who needs it tonight.
